# Test Fixtures

## Input files (`input/`)

Small 8x8 images generated once with `node e2e/generate-fixtures.mjs`.
Committed to the repository so tests are hermetic.

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `white.png` | 8x8 opaque white PNG |
| `photo.jpg` | 8x8 warm-toned JPEG |
| `mark.svg` | 8x8 SVG with white rect |
| `frame.gif` | 8x8 GIF |
| `shot.webp` | 8x8 WebP |
| `tree/a.jpg` | JPEG for recursive walk test |
| `tree/nested/b.jpg` | JPEG for nested directory test |
| `tree/skip/c.jpg` | JPEG for --exclude test |

## Expected outputs (`expected/`)

Generated by `bash e2e/generate-goldens.sh` from `packages/gainmap/`.
Each file is produced twice and verified for determinism before being committed.

Re-generate whenever the encoder changes in a way that legitimately alters output.

## checksums.sha256

SHA-256 checksums for each golden scenario, in `sha256sum -c` compatible format.
The e2e suite (both `e2e/run.sh` and `test/e2e-checksum.test.ts`) verifies checksums
by re-running each scenario through the CLI and hashing the fresh output — not by
hashing the committed files in `expected/`. The `expected/` files serve as goldens
produced by `e2e/generate-goldens.sh`; regenerate them only when the encoder changes
in a way that legitimately alters output.
